ItemId.description: The account's 26-character id; omit it to create a new one.

Name.description: The name the account is listed by.

OwnerKind.description: The party kind of the owner, such as Staff, User or Account; omit it for one of the business's own accounts.

OwnerId.description: The owner's id in its kind.

HolderName.description: The name on the account, as the bank knows it.

Country.description: The bank's two-letter ISO country code.

RoutingNumber.description: The bank's routing number; checked for the country.

AccountNumber.description: The account number in clear text; protected with the importing site's keys. Omit it to import the account without numbers.

Status.description: The status; kept only when the numbers are imported too.

StatusReason.description: Why the account has that status.

Properties.description: What other features keep on the account, by the name of the settings object; each one given replaces the stored one. NachaOriginSettings holds the Bank file (ACH) settings of one of the business's own accounts: Enabled, ImmediateDestination (a routing number, or empty for the account's bank), ImmediateDestinationName, ImmediateOrigin (ten characters at most), ImmediateOriginName, CompanyName (sixteen at most), CompanyIdentification (ten at most), CompanyEntryDescription (ten at most, such as PAYROLL) and IncludeOffset.

Accounts.description: The bank accounts to create, or update by id.
